tag: トリミングサロンの生産性

scenes.html:
「毎月、何頭でトントン？」
30万÷6,000
＝50頭
（例）割り算1回で分かる
scenes.voice: 毎月、何頭でトントンか。割り算1回で分かります。

scenes.text:
毎月かかるお金を
ざっくり足す
scenes.sm: 家賃・材料・光熱費・人件費など（例）
scenes.voice: まず、毎月かかるお金を、ざっくり足します。例えば、30万円。
scenes.illus: <svg width='860' height='654' viewBox='0 0 920 700' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='40' y='90' width='840' height='120' rx='24' fill='#fff' stroke='#3d7a55' stroke-width='4'/><text x='80' y='168' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='46' fill='#24402f' text-anchor='start'>家賃</text><text x='860' y='170' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='56' fill='#e0412f' text-anchor='end'>12万</text><rect x='40' y='240' width='840' height='120' rx='24' fill='#fff' stroke='#3d7a55' stroke-width='4'/><text x='80' y='318' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='46' fill='#24402f' text-anchor='start'>材料・光熱費</text><text x='860' y='320' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='56' fill='#e0412f' text-anchor='end'>6万</text><rect x='40' y='390' width='840' height='120' rx='24' fill='#fff' stroke='#3d7a55' stroke-width='4'/><text x='80' y='468' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='46' fill='#24402f' text-anchor='start'>人件費など</text><text x='860' y='470' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='56' fill='#e0412f' text-anchor='end'>12万</text><rect x='140' y='560' width='640' height='110' rx='24' fill='#f6d77a' stroke='none' stroke-width='0'/><text x='460' y='636' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='58' fill='#24402f' text-anchor='middle'>合計 30万円（例）</text></svg>

scenes.voice: 次に、1頭の料金で割ります。30万円わる6000円で、50頭です。
scenes.illus: <svg width='860' height='654' viewBox='0 0 920 700' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='40' y='90' width='840' height='120' rx='24' fill='#fff' stroke='#3d7a55' stroke-width='4'/><text x='80' y='168' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='46' fill='#24402f' text-anchor='start'>毎月かかるお金</text><text x='860' y='170' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='56' fill='#e0412f' text-anchor='end'>30万円</text><rect x='40' y='240' width='840' height='120' rx='24' fill='#fff' stroke='#3d7a55' stroke-width='4'/><text x='80' y='318' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='46' fill='#24402f' text-anchor='start'>1頭の料金</text><text x='860' y='320' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='56' fill='#e0412f' text-anchor='end'>6,000円</text><rect x='40' y='390' width='840' height='120' rx='24' fill='#fff' stroke='#3d7a55' stroke-width='4'/><text x='80' y='468' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='46' fill='#24402f' text-anchor='start'>30万 ÷ 6,000</text><text x='860' y='470' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='56' fill='#e0412f' text-anchor='end'>50頭</text><rect x='140' y='560' width='640' height='110' rx='24' fill='#f6d77a' stroke='none' stroke-width='0'/><text x='460' y='636' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='58' fill='#24402f' text-anchor='middle'>50頭でトントン（例）</text></svg>

scenes.voice: 最後に、営業日で割ります。25日なら、1日2頭でトントンです。
scenes.illus: <svg width='860' height='654' viewBox='0 0 920 700' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect x='40' y='90' width='840' height='120' rx='24' fill='#fff' stroke='#3d7a55' stroke-width='4'/><text x='80' y='168' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='46' fill='#24402f' text-anchor='start'>トントンの頭数</text><text x='860' y='170' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='56' fill='#e0412f' text-anchor='end'>50頭</text><rect x='40' y='240' width='840' height='120' rx='24' fill='#fff' stroke='#3d7a55' stroke-width='4'/><text x='80' y='318' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='46' fill='#24402f' text-anchor='start'>営業日</text><text x='860' y='320' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='56' fill='#e0412f' text-anchor='end'>25日</text><rect x='40' y='390' width='840' height='120' rx='24' fill='#fff' stroke='#3d7a55' stroke-width='4'/><text x='80' y='468' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='46' fill='#24402f' text-anchor='start'>50 ÷ 25</text><text x='860' y='470' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='56' fill='#e0412f' text-anchor='end'>1日2頭</text><rect x='140' y='560' width='640' height='110' rx='24' fill='#f6d77a' stroke='none' stroke-width='0'/><text x='460' y='636' font-family='Noto Sans CJK JP' font-weight='700' font-size='58' fill='#24402f' text-anchor='middle'>1日3頭なら17日目でこえる</text></svg>

scenes.sm: 明日の1頭で、試してみてください
scenes.voice: 割り算2回で、トントンの頭数が分かります。保存して、自分のお店の数字で試してね。
